about: PROQUESTPDF-v1 answer 2 (Sammy, 2026-11-02): hand-kept rules and ProQuest-name -> tracker-outlet-name pairs. tools/build_pq_aliases.py reads this file, checks every pair against the workbook (the tracker name must be an Outlet the sheet already uses; the ProQuest name must not already match it by the plain rules) and writes data/proquest_outlets.json. Add a pair only with a source note that says where the ProQuest name was seen. 'place' (optional) is a word that must appear in ProQuest's place of publication; it is how the same generic name (Daily News) is told apart between cities.

pairs.source: Sammy's own example (PROQUESTPDF-v1 answer 2; PROQUEST.md 7.4): ProQuest titles it 'The Center Square; Washington' for every state, NewsBank files the California desk as 'Center Square California, The' (26 rows in the snapshot workbook). The Texas desk ('Center Square Texas, The', 2 rows) is a separate outlet that the PC keeps apart (outlet_rules keep_separate), so it is not mapped.

Data: 7 ProQuest rows carry Outlet 'Daily News' and 4 other rows 'Daily News' with Outlet city Los Angeles; outlet_rules.json lists 'daily news' as a generic name (one outlet per city) and aliases it to 'los angeles daily news'. ProQuest prints the city after the title, so only 'Daily News; Los Angeles, Calif.' is taken as the tracker's Daily News.

clean_rules.source: existing pqparse.outletOf; ProQuest naming pattern 'New York Times, Late Edition (East Coast)', 'Wall Street Journal, Eastern edition'
existing pqparse.outletOf; ProQuest naming pattern 'Los Angeles Times (Online)'
